title: Some interactions do not call a node's `_set` function on PackedVector2Array types
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable.steam [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable (77dcf97d8) - Windows 10.0.22631 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 Threads)

### Issue description

I expect that when you hit Ctrl-Z to revert a node's property value change, all the related methods to also be called.

### Steps to reproduce

- open project
- click on the Polygon2D node
- click and drag any polygon vertex to another place
- > notice the collision polygon also updates)
- hit Ctrl+Z
- > notice only the Polygon2D node changed, but the CollisionPolygon2D remained in the altered position)
- > notice also how the console doesn't print any "hello from _set" on the output, only the default `Scene Undo: Edit Polygon`
- move a vertex again (to update the collider on the example)
- now remove a vertex from the Polygon2D node
- > Notice the collider again, didn't update, and the `_set` method wasn't called


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[_set-ctrl-z-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18551801/_set-ctrl-z-mrp.zip)
